description: Returns what a template version is made of: the body markup (html), css, head, settings (paper, margins, header, footer, fonts), sample data, data sets, data schema, translations and partials, with the version's checksum. Call it before save_template to change a template the user named, and save what you edited with that checksum as base_checksum. Reads the latest version by default, the newest draft a change builds on; published reads what renders use. Word and PowerPoint templates are documents: for them it returns the settings and data, not the document. Read-only and free.

template.description: Slug (e.g. invoice) or tpl_ id, as list_templates returns them

version.description: latest (default), published, a version number or a channel name

name: get_template_source

checksum.description: Pass it to save_template as base_checksum

title: Read the source of a template
